summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing it had cumulatively repurchased over NTD$300 million worth of its own common shares. As of May 20, 2026, the company had bought back 10,020,000 shares at an average price of NTD$108.69 per share, totaling NTD$1,089,032,948. The cumulative repurchased shares represent 0.24% of total issued shares. This is an open-market share buyback, indicating a capital return program. Investors should monitor further repurchase disclosures and any potential impact on earnings per share or share price support.
